assumptions.A01: Current user-approved group specification; fixed formulas, 0.5 h, 48 steps, N=5–10, 12-step forecast, 20-year PV life and 30-day fee allocation. Group technical-plan file supplies the 8-step history and seed convention. Current user request takes precedence where they differ.
assumptions.A02: D v0.2 scenario sizing and tariff simplification: 300 kW office, 240 kW contract, 120 kWh/60 kW BESS, 60 kWp PV, HT-Small connection assumption, fixed 0.03 SGD/kWh adder; excludes GST.
assumptions.A03: D scenario employee parking/SoC assumptions, not fitted data: truncated-normal arrival/departure; uniform arrival SoC; reserve/goal; one weekday car per slot and no weekend cars.
assumptions.A04: D constant one-way conversion-efficiency assumptions; evidence for EV round-trip order of magnitude only.
assumptions.A05: D economic transfer assumptions: fixed SGD/USD=1.35 (not historical FX), price benchmarks transferred to the chosen assets, NMC life proxy transferred to LEAF reference; AC-throughput linear proxy, no residual/calendar-age model; 5-decimal coefficient rounding.
assumptions.A06: D PV output scaling and cost interpolation assumptions: normalise the national historical forecast to an assumed 48 kW rooftop peak; capex1200 SGD/kWp, O&M1% transferred to commercial, fixed365-day year.
assumptions.A07: D synthetic office-load shape, bounded fluctuations, weekend multiplier, reproducible random seed and six-decimal CSV output precision.
assumptions.A08: D uncalibrated relative-Gaussian prediction-noise schedule and same-day boundary padding.
assumptions.A09: D four-step arithmetic fixture and standalone edge-case inputs; deliberately synthetic, not empirical operating records.
assumptions.A10: D recommended date-disjoint 14/7/7-day training/validation/test partition; no performance conclusion claimed.
